apps.localizedDescription: A free and open-source PlayStation 2 (PS2) emulator based on PCSX2, with native ARM64 JIT recompilers. Play PS2 games on your phone, PC, or gaming handheld.

versions.localizedDescription:
Automated nightly build for community testing (unsigned).

Every download is named `ARMSX2-nightly-DATE-COMMIT-PLATFORM`, so builds
from different nights stay distinguishable after you have downloaded them.

- macOS arm64: macOS-arm64.tar.xz
- Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-4K-pages.AppImage on most distros, or the 16K one on Asahi Linux and other Apple Silicon kernels (run getconf PAGESIZE if unsure)
- Windows arm64: Windows-arm64.zip
- RetroArch on Linux arm64: Linux-arm64-libretro-core.tar.zst, a 4K-page build
- Bare-display kmsdrm handhelds: Linux-arm64-SDL-handheld.tar.zst, a 4K-page build (Rocknix and Batocera run compositors, so use the Qt AppImage there instead)
- Android: Android-arm64.apk (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)
- iOS: iOS-arm64.ipa, unsigned, sideload it (installs as ARMSX2 Nightly, alongside the stable app)

Coming from an old nightly? Nightlies are now a separate app, ARMSX2 Nightly, next to stable.

- Android: stable cannot install over an old nightly. Back up your saves and memory cards, uninstall the old nightly, then install the stable APK.
- iOS: your old nightly is the ARMSX2 iOS app and still has your saves. Copy them into ARMSX2 Nightly with the Files app.

## What's new
- Android: don't tell a user to download the malisx2 pack they selected
- Tests: pin every Mali Valhall v9 and v11 name the app can meet
- Android: offer malisx2 on Mali Valhall v9 as well as v11
- tools: build the Play AAB with NDK 29, like the sideload targets
- GS/Null: add a mali-g615-malisx2 profile for the RG477V on our driver
- Android: show the malisx2 notice the way the blending and paid-copy warnings show
- GS/gsrunner: -no-dual-source runs Vulkan as a device without dual-source blending
- Android: warn when a supported Mali runs Vulkan without malisx2
- GS/Vulkan: expanded lines pair their ends by index on every device
- Android: regenerate the PGO profile after bmd's texture hash changes
- Android: publish a screenshot to the gallery only once the core has written all of it
- GS/gsrunner: -no-provoking-vertex runs Vulkan as a device without provokingVertexLast
- Android: Auto picks Vulkan on Mali Valhall v9 and v11
- GS: allow push descriptors on malisx2 when it advertises enough of them
- GS: exempt malisx2 from the Mali destination-read rows once it has ROAA
- GS/TC: reuse a texture's hash while the pages it reads are unwritten
- GS: mark local memory pages at the stores the hardware renderer makes
- GS: stamp the pages of local memory that a store writes
- GS/TC: hash texture blocks without copying each one into XXH3's buffer
- GS: exempt malisx2 from the r44p1 self-read rule
- GS: move the malisx2 identity predicate into the profile layer
- Android: regenerate the PGO profile for 2.8.2
- GS: log which driver-profile rules and device rules matched
- GS: recognise the malisx2 driver as well as its old libmali name
- Quick menu: Texture Upscaling under the internal resolution
- i18n: bmd's Texture Upscaling picker and preset scanning in 19 languages
- Arcade: Soul Calibur II's Conquest card goes in without a note
- Controls: two controllers plug in Player 2's port again, wherever they play
- Save states: keep up to five autosaves
- Controls: several controllers can play one player
- IOP: an ELF picked through Android's file picker boots again (#759)
- Android: save state hotkeys always answer, and a held button is let go (#784)
- Android: the screen resolution override keeps a portrait screen's shape (#790)
- Touch: hidden extra widgets no longer leave dead spots (#796)
- Arcade: Soul Calibur II starts with its Conquest card

Full changelog: https://github.com/ARMSX2/ARMSX2/compare/nightly-20261006...e194ae09e6546840dc9854341c3b15424b007495
